caption: Lightning flashes far beyond a mountain range at night, and the outline of the peaks stands out against the lit sky for an instant.

sa.check: Lightning flashes in the sky beyond the range.
The peaks stand out as dark outlines against the lit sky.
The flash is far off, behind the mountains rather than over the foreground.
The sky returns to dark after the flash.

pc.expect: Each flash is brief: the sky brightens and returns to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The sky stays lit for the rest of the clip; or brightens steadily without ending; or turns to daylight; or the light fades in slowly like a sunrise.

pc.expect: The light comes from behind the range: the sky and clouds beyond the peaks brighten while the near faces of the mountains stay dark, so the peaks are silhouettes.
pc.fail: The near faces of the mountains light up while the sky behind stays dark; or the foreground brightens more than the sky; or the peaks glow brighter than the sky behind them.

pc.expect: The outline of the range is the same in lit and dark frames: the same peaks in the same places.
pc.fail: Peaks appear or vanish between the dark and lit frames; or the ridge line changes shape; or the range shifts across the frame while the foreground stays put.

pc.expect: The mountains and the foreground stay still through the flash; only the light changes; clouds drift slowly if at all.
pc.fail: The mountains shift or shake at the flash; or foreground trees or rocks move at the flash; or clouds jump to new shapes between one frame and the next.

pc.expect: The mountains stay solid ground; the flash does not pass through them or light them from within.
pc.fail: A mountain becomes transparent with the flash seen through it; or the range melts into cloud; or a bolt emerges from inside a peak; or the range morphs into a different landscape.

pc.expect: The night colours of sky and land are consistent before and after; the flash whitens or blues the sky only briefly.
pc.fail: The sky changes colour permanently after the flash; or the mountains change colour; or the foreground changes colour.
